Package org.osgi.impl.service.useradmin

Class UAProperties

java.lang.Object
java.util.Dictionary<String,Object>
org.osgi.impl.service.useradmin.UAProperties
Direct Known Subclasses:
UACredentials
public class UAProperties extends Dictionary<String,Object>
A dictionary with permissions checks for setting, changing, and deleting values.

Role properties are instances of this class. Changes to these objects are propagated to the

invalid reference 
UserAdmin
service and made persistent. Only keys of the type String are supported, and only values of type String or of type byte[] are supported. If an attempt is made to store a value of a type other than what is supported, an exception of type IllegalArgumentException will be raised.

A UserAdminPermissionwith the action changeProperty is required to change a Role's properties.
